title: data_analysis.requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs DataAnalysisAgent to analyze an uploaded external dataset against the frozen external experiment package, at a given strictness level. DataAnalysisAgent itself is out of scope for this task -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

external_data_upload_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the uploaded external dataset.

external_experiment_package_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen external experiment package the data is being analyzed against.

strictness.description: Strictness level DataAnalysisAgent should apply when assessing QC / consensus.
